localMedia.settings.hint.computeType: Higher precision is slower, and a precision the model cannot use fails at check time.

localMedia.settings.hint.maxRecordingSec: At the limit the recording ends and what was captured is transcribed rather than discarded.
localMedia.settings.hint.vadFilter: Skips silent stretches, usually faster; may drop words in slow or pause-heavy speech.
localMedia.settings.hint.modelKind: Must match the actual model format; a mismatch fails when the model loads.
localMedia.settings.hint.lexiconPath: Optional. Some models need a matching lexicon.
localMedia.settings.hint.dataDir: Optional. Needed by models that use the espeak-ng frontend.
localMedia.settings.hint.dictDir: Optional. Used by models that need word segmentation, such as Chinese voices.
localMedia.settings.hint.ruleFsts: One absolute path per line, applied in order. Blank lines are ignored.
localMedia.settings.hint.speakerId: The speaker index for a multi-speaker model; use 0 for a single-speaker model.
localMedia.settings.hint.speed: Between 0.5 and 2.0; 1.0 is the model's own pace.
localMedia.settings.hint.numThreads: Between 1 and 16. More than the physical core count rarely helps.
